content.short: Moni Social API provides a data layer for social analytics and ready-to-use Twitter analytics for Web3 products.
content.description: Moni Social API provides a data layer for social analytics, delivering ready-to-use Twitter analytics for Web3 products. By avoiding complex integrations and manual data parsing, developers receive social scoring, engagement metrics, and trend insights instantly. The REST API remains simple, with transparent rate limits and flexible pricing, helping teams cut infrastructure costs, accelerate development, and make data-driven decisions without the overhead of collecting data.
